limitations: Contextual literal adaptation covers imported qualified static calls and managed class method calls
Metadata headers are generated for explicitly selected types
Constructor arguments currently require exact supported CLI types
Generic consumption is partial; generic declarations/methods, constraints/variance, delegates and events remain incomplete
No mixed-mode PE output or ijwhost integration yet
Unsupported AST nodes are errors; this is not a conforming general C++/CLI compiler
Indexed properties currently require one index parameter; overloads require the same value type and accessor forms; static indexed/auto-properties and static compound updates remain unsupported
Interface surrogates use C++ abstract bases; interface-only classes need an explicit Object base for Object upcasts

Interface methods and property accessors require declarations without bodies; named overrides cover one imported-interface target; source-interface renamed methods, target lists and class-target overrides remain unsupported
Managed arrays currently require rank one; no aggregate initializers or covariance
Managed destructors/finalizers, covariance metadata and managed operator metadata are explicitly rejected
Native bridges require extern-C scalars or unmanaged pointers; bool/automatic marshalling, callbacks and automatic native partitioning are not enabled
Implicit boxing into Object/interfaces/primitive boxes and multi-translation-unit linking remain unimplemented
WPF DirectWriteForwarder and System.Printing are not compiled by this frontend yet
Value classes currently exclude nested types, bases/interfaces, virtual methods, native pointer fields and custom zero-argument constructors

Boxing covers explicit safe_cast to Object and implicit boxing into matching selected value-class handles; handle upcasts, primitive boxes, constrained dispatch and boxed operator overloads remain incomplete

Tracking references exclude constructors, fields and byref returns; pin_ptr is limited to initialized primitive block locals, and interior_ptr to primitive addresses/read dereferences; managed pointer assignments, unmanaged pointer arithmetic and intrinsic returns are not implemented
Layout attributes currently appear individually before managed declarations; inherited layout types, bitfields and general custom attributes remain unsupported
CLI enum operations currently cover comparisons, explicit casts and bitwise OR/AND/XOR/complement; additive/increment/compound enum operators remain incomplete
Switch initializers and GNU case ranges are rejected; switch labels cannot enter generated protected/pinned scopes
Source-defined static constructors currently cover ref/value classes in one translation unit; interface static constructors remain unsupported
Imported generic nested types remain unsupported; indexed compound updates used as values are unsupported; static template-field facades can produce native definition warnings

For each currently requires braced bodies and managed array/reference-enumerator handles; MoveNext currently requires bool; tracking-reference variables and value/native enumerators remain unsupported

Interop attributes remain a selected subset: canonical literal GUIDs, imported interfaces, zero/one positional arguments and selected parameter marshal kinds; coclass activation, field/return marshal metadata, named marshal options and general custom attributes remain unsupported
Native SDK calls are not automatically partitioned; native record pointers remain opaque native addresses, and native integer boxes remain unsupported
